title: drymocallis campanulata
intro: Drymocallis campanulata, commonly known as Indian strawberry or western strawberry, is a flowering plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of North America and is known for its edible red berries and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Drymocallis campanulata include its ability to treat various ailments such as diarrhea, fever, and inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and antibacterial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
